description: Source code for WPA Supplicant endpoint API functions, including commands for disconnecting, retrieving status, managing WPS, and handling scan results within a Wi-Fi management context.

methods.name: s_sendWpaSuppCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to wpa_supplicant for a specific endpoint, checking response for 'OK'.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_ep_disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the endpoint from an AP by sending 'DISCONNECT' command.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_ep_getAllStatusDetails
methods.description: Retrieves global status information of an endpoint, such as BSSID, frequency, SSID, WPA state, etc.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_ep_getOneStatusDetail
methods.description: Retrieves a specific status detail field from the endpoint's status.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_ep_increaseSecurityModeInCreds
methods.description: Increases WPS credentials security mode to WPA2-WPA3-Personal if supported by scanned APs.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_ep_getScanResults
methods.description: Fetches scan results from wpa_supplicant, parsing BSS info and security modes.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_ep_getBssScanInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed BSS scan info for a specific BSSID.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_ep_getBssScanInfoExt
methods.description: Retrieves extended BSS scan info, including IEs and wireless device info elements.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_getBssidFromStatusDetails
methods.description: Extracts BSSID from status info string.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_getOperStdFromStatusDetails
methods.description: Determines operational standard (e.g., 802.11ac, ax) from status info.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_ep_getBssid
methods.description: Gets the BSSID of the connected AP.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_ep_getSsid
methods.description: Gets the SSID of the connected AP.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_getConnStatusFromStatusDetails
methods.description: Maps wpa_state string to connection status enum.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_ep_getConnState
methods.description: Retrieves current connection state of endpoint.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_ep_startWpsPbc
methods.description: Starts WPS PBC (Push Button Configuration) process.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_ep_startWpsPin
methods.description: Starts WPS PIN process with specified PIN.
